title: Euler-Poincare Reduction: A Geometric Treatment of the Relativistic Spinning Particle
summary: The heavy top is a classic example of Euler-Poincare reduction on a semidirect product group, demonstrating how an advected quantity-the direction of gravity-couples to rotational motion. While the description of relativistic spinning particles via Lie group configurations is well established in Hamiltonian (symplectic) mechanics, we demonstrate that an explicit Lagrangian Euler-Poincare reduction provides a direct, transparent parallel to the heavy top. Specifically, we show that the free relativistic spinning particle on the Poincare group is the precise Lorentzian analog of this system,…
